limitations: Characteristic 2 is excluded, and only the socle filtration, multipermutation level, and the prime-field extremal consequence are claimed. Equivalent older coverage under different substitution-group or brace terminology remains a residual literature risk.
scientific_integrity: The arbitrary-field statement is proved by an exact lambda-kernel calculation and induction through brace quotients. Finite enumeration is included only as a reproducibility check and is not used to infer the general theorem.
title: Truncated Nottingham braces attain maximal multipermutation level at every odd prime
